title: Sandbar Adventure Cruise in the Florida Keys
includes: Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the enchanting beauty of the Florida Keys with Island Girls Excursions. This adventure combines relaxing sandbar experiences with stunning sunset cruises. Unwind on your spacious 52’ catamaran, complete with complimentary snacks and drinks while soaking up the sun or exploring the crystal-clear waters. Your experienced crew will ensure a smooth sailing experience, showcasing the best spots in the area. Perfect for groups seeking relaxation, celebration, or exploration, this tour promises unforgettable memories in paradise. 

- Enjoy a leisurely sandbar trip with paddleboarding and floats
- Experience breathtaking sunset views while sipping drinks
- Spacious and comfortable 52’ catamaran with Wi-Fi
- Friendly and knowledgeable crew dedicated to your safety and enjoyment
